findings.title: Default evidence pack fabricates successful adversarial observations without marking simulation
findings.evidence: default_nemesis hardcodes INODE_UNCHANGED_EPERM_CONFIRMED, ZERO_UNAUTHORIZED_EFFECTS_OVER_10000_TRIALS and other successes; lines 642-646 serialize them without executing campaigns. Lines 668 and 832-860 create synthetic ledger/report and describe control execution.
findings.trigger: Call compile_pack(output_dir) without externally supplied campaign evidence.
findings.impact: Signed audit deliverables present invented observations as independently verifiable control execution; hashes authenticate generated content, not those claimed experiments.

findings.title: Output directory is recursively deleted before validating compilation inputs
findings.evidence: if out_path.exists(): shutil.rmtree(out_path) precedes load_canonical_claims at line 595; no pack marker or empty-directory check.
findings.trigger: Caller supplies an existing directory containing unrelated files, or recompiles into an existing directory and canonical claims loading then fails.
findings.impact: Unrelated files or the last good evidence pack are permanently removed before a replacement is ready.

findings.title: Existing-ledger integrity verdict is ignored by compiler
findings.evidence: verify_offline_evidence returns verified/integrity_verified flags; compile_pack reads only total_entries and merkle_root at 655-658. Verifier lines 321-345 returns false with empty root for invalid ordering/version.
findings.trigger: Compile using existing_ledger_path whose chain or sequence is invalid.
findings.impact: Compilation can return and sign a success-shaped deliverable around rejected evidence instead of aborting; independent verifier may subsequently reject it.

findings.title: Unverified evidence status is accepted as verified citation
findings.evidence: register persists record.status without restricting it; lookup returns any cache record; intercept patent/arXiv/DOI branches accept if record without checking status.
findings.trigger: Register/load an EvidenceRecord with status REVOKED or UNVERIFIED and a 64-character nonempty digest, then intercept its citation under STRICT_ABORT.
findings.impact: Citation passes strict enforcement, appears in verified_citations and contributes to a COMMITTED result despite its explicit unverified status.

findings.title: Failed SQLite registration leaves evidence trusted in memory
findings.evidence: register assigns self._cache[key] = record before opening and committing SQLite at lines 125-144; no rollback removes the cache entry on failure.
findings.trigger: SQLite INSERT/connect fails, for example locked database or read-only database, and caller handles exception while retaining registry.
findings.impact: lookup and interceptor accept evidence whose durable registration failed; current process and reopened registry disagree about trusted evidence.

tool_limitations: No codebase-memory graph tools exposed in native session; targeted text reads and rg used.
Static audit only; no repository tests, builds, runtime experiments, network API verification, or physical claims verification performed.
External SDK reference documents were read for internal consistency; current external API correctness was not certified.
All assigned text SHA-256 digests matched shard manifest; CLAUDE.md metadata target matched and was not followed.
